name: assembly
description: flacmn deck pro, round 14 as built: folded shell (front leaning back 15 deg) and flat back plate, DAC Pro, both PEC11R-4215F encoders (shafts cut to 12 mm, for 10 mm caps), and the Raspberry Pi 5 model standing in for the Pi 4. Not modelled: the 5in DSI screen, knob caps, standoffs, screws.
_frames: World: x right, y back from the front face, z up. Sheet parts are stood up (sheet (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y)): xform rows are the images of the part's x, y, z axes, then the translation. Pi and DAC turned 180 deg about z (USB/Ethernet to -x, sockets to the back). Encoders: shaft (+z) to -y, body top against the front face's inner side (y = t). Round 14: the shell and encoders are laid out with the face upright (face frame) and turned -15 deg about x through y = z = 0.

expected._comment: Envelope: 241 x 88.5 (shell). Depth 100.331: from the shell's front bottom (the 105 deg fold's hinge corner sits at y = 0.169, the draft's shell bbox gives the same 0.17) to the back plate's outer face at 100.5. The encoder shafts end behind the face line (tips at face-frame y = -11 lean back to y > 0).
allowed_interference: GPIO header in the DAC Pro's socket
